Ivy L: quick onboarding question — i'm prepping a partner walkthrough and my hosted key started returning 429s when i hit ~12 concurrent streams. which key should i be using for a demo, and is there a fast path to get a short burst?

Carlos (DevEx): hey Ivy, welcome! for interactive demos we prefer the sandbox key to avoid touching prod quotas. sandbox supports streaming/embeddings but with smaller caps. if you need steadier throughput for a customer session, we can request a temporary hosted burst.

Ivy L: sandbox gave me some 429s too. i was running the load from our CI runners — could that be the problem?

Rina (Infra): yes, CI egress IPs often hit proxy-level buckets because many runners share the same NAT. quick reproducible check: run this curl from your laptop off VPN and from the CI host and compare.

Rina (Infra): ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Ivy L: ah okay. if it's an IP bucket, can infra hand out a temporary egress IP or should i request a hosted burst?

Rina (Infra): we can sometimes assign a short-lived egress IP for a demo window (usually 1-4 hours). include that ask in a support ticket and we'll evaluate. if you need higher token throughput beyond IP isolation, request a hosted quota bump instead.

Ivy L: what's the easiest way to request that bump?

Carlos (DevEx): open a support ticket in the Console (Help > Support > Request quota increase). In the ticket include: project id, demo start/end times, peak QPS, whether you're streaming, and note you may need a dedicated egress IP. Tag @infra and @devex.

Ivy L: any guidance for retry/backoff? my first naive retries spiked the throttling.

Rina (Infra): use exponential backoff with jitter and cap total in-flight requests. Our SDKs have sane defaults. If you implement custom retry: base ~200ms, multiplier 2x, jitter, max backoff ~3-5s, and abort after ~5 attempts. avoid immediate tight loops on 429.

Carlos (DevEx): if you paste the ticket link here I can ping infra for faster review during business hours. For short demos we often turn around a small burst within 1-2 hours when capacity allows.

Ivy L: ticket #9042 created with details, switching my rehearsal to laptop and lowering concurrency for now. thanks everyone! :pray:
